rows.label: VOCALIZATION

rows.label: GUIDEBOOK

rows.label: HAGIOGRAPHY

rows.label: IDIOT LIGHT

rows.label: CALORIE CHART

rows.label: CACHET

rows.label: SCANDAL

rows.label: NUMBER SYSTEM

rows.label: JARGON

rows.label: DICTATE

rows.label: DISTRESS CALL

rows.label: LETTERPRESS

rows.label: PLOT LINE

rows.label: OFFBEAT

rows.label: TOPIC

rows.label: MISREADING

rows.label: NONAGGRESSION

rows.label: COUNTEROFFER

rows.label: SCANSION
rows.clue: Analysis of verse into metrical patterns

rows.label: PRESENT TENSE

rows.label: TALKING POINT

rows.label: WORKBOOK
rows.clue: A student's book or booklet containing problems with spaces for solving them

rows.label: GUESS

rows.label: EXHIBIT
rows.clue: An object or statement produced before a court of law and referred to while giving evidence

rows.label: SERIOUS MUSIC
rows.clue: Traditional genre of music conforming to an established form and appealing to critical interest and developed musical taste

rows.label: HEADER

rows.label: CONSONANT
rows.clue: A speech sound that is not a vowel

rows.label: ASIDE

rows.label: SILVER SCREEN
rows.clue: The film industry

rows.label: HEALTH CODE
rows.clue: Set of standards established and enforced by government for health requirements as in plumbing etc

rows.label: DUMP ROUTINE

rows.label: BOWING
rows.clue: Bending the head or body or knee as a sign of reverence or submission or shame or greeting

rows.label: GUIDELINE
rows.clue: A light line that is used in lettering to help align the letters

rows.label: DOUBLE FLAT
rows.clue: A musical notation of two flats in front of a note indicating that it is to be lowered by two semitones

rows.label: EMOTICON
rows.clue: A representation of a facial expression (as a smile or frown) created by typing a sequence of characters in sending email

rows.label: SPRUNG RHYTHM
rows.clue: A poetic rhythm that imitates the rhythm of speech

rows.label: DISCOGRAPHY
rows.clue: A descriptive catalog of musical recordings

rows.clue: Pronouns and verbs that are used to refer to something other than the speaker or addressee of the language in which they occur

rows.label: METALANGUAGE

rows.label: TREATY

rows.label: TABLE TURNING

rows.label: SORT PROGRAM

rows.label: SMEAR WORD

rows.label: ALL CLEAR

rows.clue: A positional system of numeration that uses binary digits and a radix of two

rows.label: TERM PAPER
